title: Federal government hands Governor Kundi all KP chief minister powers
detail: A Cabinet Division gazette notification dated Nov 4 (Federal Government Order No. 3/2026) transferred the chief minister's powers in KP to Governor Faisal Karim Kundi, effective immediately, under the Constitution, provincial legislation and the KP Government Rules of Business 1985. The order follows the Oct 11 emergency and governor's rule under Articles 232 and 234, cited on security grounds. The governor must send monthly reports to Islamabad and is assisted by an advisory council. PTI calls the measures unconstitutional and plans to challenge them in the Peshawar High Court.
